presentation.label: RETRIG GRID
presentation.summary: Pad retrigs (RTRG + pad) fall on the sequencer's straight grid while it plays, instead of counting from the press; swing is not followed yet.
presentation.overview: Stock plays a retriggered pad at once and repeats it at the RETRIG rate counted from the press, so a roll started between two steps stays between the steps. With Retrig Grid the pad still sounds at the press, and every retrig after it falls on the grid of the rate's note values, in bars from PLAY: 1/16 on the steps, 1/4 on the beats, 1/12 on the triplets. A grid point closer than half a period to the press is skipped. The grid is straight (no swing); with the sequencer stopped, pads retrigger from the press as stock. A GLOBAL row turns it off.
highlights: Rolls lock to the steps whenever you come in; the first hit stays at the press.
Every RETRIG rate, triplets and 1/5 included, lines up with the bar from PLAY.
LENGTH, VEL.CUR, ALWAYS ON and rate changes while RTRG is held work as stock.
No stock code patched: it re-times the series on core-ar2's audio-block event.
usage: Hold RTRG and press the BD pad between two steps, then keep it held: BD sounds at once, and the retrigs after it fall on the steps.
Still holding RTRG, set RETRIG to 1/4, then to 1/12, and play the pad again: the roll lands on the beats, then on the triplets of the bar.
To compare with stock, press GLOBAL, go down to RETRIG GRID ON and press YES: it reads RETRIG GRID OFF, and rolls follow the press again.

access.location: Pad retrigs (RTRG + pad, or a pad set to ALWAYS ON) while the sequencer plays; the switch is the last row of the GLOBAL menu.
steps: Press PLAY, hold RTRG and play pads.
Press GLOBAL, go down past SYSTEM to RETRIG GRID ON, and press YES to switch it OFF or back ON.

controls.name: RETRIG GRID
controls.doc: ON puts pad retrigs on the sequencer's grid while it plays; OFF leaves them as stock. GLOBAL menu, after SYSTEM; YES turns it over. Kept with the project.

limitations: No swing yet: the grid is straight, so with swing above 50 % the retrigs miss the swung off-beat 16ths. Micro timing is not followed either.
The grid counts bars from PLAY in the sequencer's 24 PPQN pulses, through tempo, speed and pattern changes; a track with its own speed or length still gets this grid.
The first gap after the press is half to one and a half periods; at 1/1 the first retrig can come up to a bar and a half later.
With the sequencer stopped, pads retrigger from the press, as stock.

load.display: About 16 instructions an audio block, about 50 after a pad retrig
load.conditions: Counted from the compiled ev_render_out handler: the sequencer's pulse word and three SRAM reads each block until a pad has retriggered; then the sum of the twelve retrig deadlines each block, and the per-track pass only when a deadline moves (a retrig tick or a press). Not measured on a unit.

hardware.summary: Build MD06 (a core-ar2 0.7 draft + loop-sync 0.3.1 + send-fx + this source's retrig-grid object fdec6df5) on the author's unit: while playing, a tempo change and a speed change from 1x to 2x left the pad retrigs on the grid, as the author reported. The earlier source (RG04, in LF18 on core-ar2 0.3) passed the five checks of its sheet.
limitations: Informal listening test; no timing measured on the unit; duration not recorded; firmware not read back. MD06.syx sha256 ea02c82aaed14bac7dd04f1e6a677277507a793569607aeec34f06dfd30e55b8.
This source was heard with a core-ar2 0.7 draft and other modules, not with the released core-ar2 0.3 alone.
External MIDI clock, a pattern change while playing, per-step sequencer retrigs and SAVE/LOAD PROJECT of the switch not reported.

tests.summary: rytm-emu 3c4c42c, build RG05, 127 BPM: after the first hit, every pad retrig lands within 2 samples of the grid at 1/16, 1/4, 1/12, 1/32 and 1/80, for four press positions, with RTRG and with ALWAYS ON, and after a speed change to 2x or 3/2x while playing; stopped and OFF behave as stock. Unit (author, by ear): LF18 (the earlier source) good on the five checks of its sheet; MD06 (this source) kept the retrigs on the grid through a tempo change and a 1x to 2x speed change while playing. See TESTING.md.
